best_idea: After a server-confirmed kill, keep the body for a fixed 2.0 s, drop its nameplate on the first frame, and fade it linearly to invisible on frame time before removing it.
decision_why: The 2 s linear corpse fade is a clean client-only death beat that never touches the kill; we keep the idea and fix the id-0 removal leak, the missing material cleanup and the id-keyed dedupe in our code.
acceptance: In the world, a monster killed by the server's delete packet loses its nameplate at once, its body fades from opaque to invisible over 2.0 s, then leaves the scene; a server test asserts the kill is recorded before any fade starts, and a client test asserts the body is removed on the first frame after 2.0 s.
